svg.title: nano i2c wiring
svg.text: Nano ESP32 to the shared I2C peripherals
5 V module reference circuit with bidirectional level translation. Proposed wiring, not an as-built record.
Both shifter GND pins share a common ground.
Nano GPIO is 3.3 V only. Keep 5 V pull-ups on the HV side. DS1307 VCC requires 4.5-5.5 V.
Assumes a 5 V LCD backpack and an I2C-compatible shifter with suitable pull-ups. Verify actual modules and supply current.
